source_inputs.native_M15: Exactly sealed Stage-A official OKX inputs; no recollection, refetch, Bybit series, or development-window change
source_inputs.rate_kind: actual signed historical realized settlement rates, source verified in Stage A

risk_and_quantity.fixed_R_cash_denominator_USDT: abs(E_ref-S_ref)+0.0008*(E_ref+S_ref), per one base coin from emitted reference-grid order; unchanged by scenario, fill, funding and doubled costs

closed_cash_formula.price_convention: Entry touch executes at limit; stop/target executes at protected trigger; gap executes at exact observed open; native SFP close executes at exact observed close. Slippage is a separate modeled cash debit, not a second price adjustment.

funding.settlement_selection: Use only actual sealed rows t with a feasible open position at t; no forecast, current cap, fixed-schedule inference or rate in a pre-entry decision.
funding.cash_formula_each_USDT: -d*actual_signed_rate(t)*Q*proxy_price(t); positive rate debits LONG and credits SHORT
funding.proxy_price: exact positive finite close of the sealed native M15 bar ending at settlement t; this is a modeled settlement-mark proxy, not verified historical OKX mark price
funding.timestamp_boundary: When fill or exit occurrence can equal settlement t, do not presume ordering. Enumerate exposure/flat states consistent with fill_time_bounds, exit_time_bounds, fill-before-exit, all actual settlement timestamps and other observed events; select the minimum total signed funding cash among coherent feasible timelines. A debit is included and an uncertain credit excluded where feasible.
funding.uncertain_wick_time: Open event has [bar_start,bar_start]; wick fill/exit has [bar_start,bar_end]; native close has [bar_end,bar_end]. Observation-at bar end does not collapse a wick occurrence interval.
funding.missing_row_or_proxy: UNRESOLVED_FUNDING_PRICE_OR_COVERAGE, qualification STOP; never substitute zero
funding.unfilled: No funding charged or credited to an order that is unfilled in that scenario
funding.filled_EOF: No invented terminal exit; unknown filled outcome forces STOP
funding.doubling: Historical signed funding rate/cash is unchanged in doubled fee/slippage column

later_verified_costs: If an applicable true account fee/slippage exceeds the frozen doubled envelope, requalification is required before Paper or LIVE. This model does not claim that the envelope bounds unverified true exchange costs.
